title: Give Your Coding Agents a Memory You Own
summary_zh: 文章介绍如何为 Claude Code 等编码智能体构建一套用户自主掌控的持久记忆层，避免上下文在会话间丢失或被锁定在特定厂商。核心价值在于提供开源、可自托管的记忆方案，让智能体跨会话记住项目约定、决策与偏好，从而提升长期协作效率。

title: v2.1.260
content: What's changed Added a diff panel that opens beside the conversation in fullscreen mode and shows your uncommitted changes as Claude edits; toggle it with /diff Added a likely cause for prompt-cache misses (e.g. tool definitions or system prompt changed, idle past the TTL) to /cost and the status line's prompt_cache field Added /reload-plugins to headless sessions, so it appears in the Claude Code Desktop and SDK command lists Added a text form of /advisor ( /advisor , /advisor <model> , /advisor off ) for the desktop app, Remote Control, and other headless ( -p /Agent SDK) sessions Added oidc.scope_on_refresh to the Claude apps gateway for IdPs that return an id_token on refresh only when asked for openid again Added Claude apps gateway support for newer Claude Desktop keys in desktop policy blocks, including userPluginMarketplacesEnabled and userPluginUploadsEnabled Fixed Edit / Write / Read permission rules whose path contains parentheses being dropped as invalid or ignored by the B
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.260 版本更新：新增全屏模式下的 /diff 差异面板，可实时查看 Claude 编辑产生的未提交变更；/cost 与状态栏新增 prompt-cache 未命中原因提示，便于排查成本问题。同时为 headless/SDK 会话补充了 /reload-plugins 和文本形式的 /advisor 命令，并增强了企业网关的 OIDC 配置支持。

title: Fine-tuning a 350M Model for Better Structured Outputs in 100 GRPO Steps
summary_zh: 文章介绍了如何用 GRPO 强化学习方法在仅 100 步内微调一个 350M 参数的小模型，显著提升其结构化输出（如 JSON）的准确性。核心价值在于展示了小模型经低成本 RL 训练即可可靠地产出符合 schema 的结构化数据，对构建 LLM 工作流中的工具调用与数据抽取环节有实际参考意义。

title: Training a coding model to paint watercolours with TRL and OpenEnv
summary_zh: 文章介绍如何使用 TRL 与 OpenEnv 对编程模型进行强化学习训练，让模型通过编写代码来生成水彩画风格作品。核心价值在于展示了基于环境交互的 RL 后训练流程（环境定义、奖励设计、训练循环），为定制化训练代码模型提供了可复用的技术范式。

title: GPT-6 Astra: an automated AI Engineer you can hire for <$6 an hour
content: We spent 20B+ tokens of GPT-6 Astra to explore everything. Here’s our learnings.
summary_zh: Latent Space 团队消耗 20B+ tokens 深度测评 GPT-6 Astra，探讨其作为「每小时不到 6 美元的自动化 AI 工程师」的实际能力边界。文章聚焦自主编程智能体的成本效益与工程实践，对评估 AI 编程工具的团队具有参考价值，但摘要内容极少，具体结论需读原文验证。

title: PRs NOT Welcome: How Top AI Open Source Projects Are Managing Thousands of Contributors
content: Vercel’s AI SDK, Astro, Flue and tldraw are replacing drive-by community PRs with software factories, where teams of agents apply fixes and features.
author: Richard MacManus
summary_zh: 文章探讨 Vercel AI SDK、Astro、tldraw 等顶级 AI 开源项目如何应对海量社区贡献者：不再接受零散的社区 PR，转而采用「软件工厂」模式，由 AI 代理团队统一实施修复与新功能。这反映了 AI 编程代理正在重塑开源协作与代码维护的工作流。

title: How to Evaluate Agentic RAG With RAGAS
content: Scored a tool-calling RAG agent with RAGAS, Pinecone and Cohere. The low retrieval numbers turned out to be corpus coverage, not retrieval quality. Read All
author: trpevski
summary_zh: 文章介绍如何使用RAGAS框架对具备工具调用能力的Agentic RAG系统进行评估，技术栈结合Pinecone向量库与Cohere模型。核心发现是：低检索评分的根因是语料库覆盖不足而非检索算法质量，提醒开发者在优化RAG时先排查数据覆盖问题。对构建LLM工作流和评估Agent系统具有实践参考价值。

title: How to build your company OS
source: The Advanced Guide to Claude Code
content: A playbook manual on how to build your entire company with AI as a foundation. Collab with Aakash Gupta (Product Growth)
author: Mikhail Shcheglov
summary_zh: 文章是一篇与 Aakash Gupta（Product Growth）合作的实践手册，讲述如何以 AI 为基础构建整个公司的操作系统（Company OS），将 Claude Code 等 AI 工具嵌入公司运营各环节。核心价值在于提供从个人提效到组织级 AI 化的系统性思路，但摘要信息有限，具体方法细节需阅读全文。

title: What will this actually cost per month? A method for pricing an LLM workload before you commit
content: You are picking a model for a feature that is about to ship. The provider pages give you a price per million tokens. Your product manager asks what the monthly bill will be. You do not have a good answer, because the price you were given is denominated in a unit nobody in the room thinks in. That gap is where most model-selection decisions get made badly. People pick on benchmark scores and vibes, ship, and find out the cost six weeks later when the invoice arrives with no per-feature attribution on it. The fix is four multiplications you can do before writing any code. This article walks the arithmetic with an illustrative workload, then covers the part the arithmetic misses, which is the part that usually decides the answer. Step one: describe the workload in tokens, not requests You cannot price a model against "a support assistant." You can price it against a workload described in four numbers: Calls per day. Input tokens per call, including the system prompt, retrieved context, an
author: Weio
summary_zh: 文章提出一套在编码前估算 LLM 工作负载月度成本的方法：将需求从「请求数」换算为「token 数」，通过四步乘法把供应商的每百万 token 单价转化为可向 PM 汇报的月账单。同时指出纯算术之外的隐藏因素（如上下文长度、重试、缓存等）往往才是决定选型的关键，有助于避免凭基准分数和直觉选模型后被账单突袭。

title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
content: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable broadly deployed model and our first to reach the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under our Preparedness Framework.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra 的安全概览，称其为目前能力最强的广泛部署模型，也是首个在 Preparedness Framework 下达到网络安全能力「Critical」级别的模型。文章聚焦模型安全评估与风险分级，对了解前沿模型能力边界及其安全治理框架有参考价值，但与 Claude Code 具体使用或编程工作流关联较弱。

title: [AINews] Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1: new SOTA model, 75% cache price cut but 70% more output tokens
content: Queue the usual rush of model launches...
summary_zh: Latent Space AINews 报道 Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1 发布：新的 SOTA 模型，prompt cache 价格下调 75%，但输出 token 数增加约 70%，对实际使用成本和推理表现有直接影响。对 Claude Code 用户而言，模型能力提升与定价结构变化是评估工作流成本的重要信息。文章正文极简，信息密度有限，需结合官方公告进一步了解细节。

title: What Is the CCAR-F Exam, and Is It Worth It? A Decision Guide for Claude Builders
content: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations eligibility, cost, domains, practice questions, study plan, and whether the certification is worth it.
author: Karo (Product with Attitude)
summary_zh: 文章介绍 Anthropic 推出的 Claude Certified Architect – Foundations（CCAR-F）认证考试，涵盖报考资格、费用、考试领域、练习题与学习计划，并给出「是否值得考」的决策指南。对于希望系统化掌握 Claude 平台知识、或需要向雇主/客户证明 Claude 构建能力的开发者具有参考价值，但本身不涉及具体编程技巧。

title: GPT‑6 Astra
content: GPT‑6 Astra GPT-6 Astra is "rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days will become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS" - I've not tried it yet myself, so I don't have a great deal to say about it yet. It's going to be API priced at the same rate as Claude Fable 5 and 5.1: $10/million input and $50/million output. This is clearly OpenAI's Fable competitor, and appears to score higher than Fable on most of OpenAI's self-reported benchmarks. Most impressively, Astra scores 99.9% on the recent (released in March) ARC-AGI 3 benchmark - though notably Fable 5 does not yet have a published result, and the ARC-AGI blog notes that the 99.9% score was achieved for $19K using OpenAI's custom "Provider Adapter harness", while the default ARC-AGI harness scored 62.7% for $26K. summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，定位为 Claude Fable 5/5.1 的直接竞争者，API 定价与 Fable 持平（$10/M 输入、$50/M 输出），逐步向 ChatGPT 付费用户及 API/AWS 开放。据 OpenAI 自报基准，Astra 在多数测试中超过 Fable，ARC-AGI 3 达 99.9%，但作者尚未亲测且指出该分数耗费 $19K 算力、Fable 5 暂无对比结果。文章为简短的模型发布速记，价值在于前沿模型格局与定价对比参考。

title: I Run Four AI Products Alone: The Fifth One Took Three Days - and Claude Designed All of It
content: I run four AI products alone. Before every launch I wasted afternoons reverse-engineering how competitors got their first users, so I built Tracetify: paste a URL, get a launch timeline with dated evidence from 12 public sources. I built it in about three days with Claude and let it make every UI decision — the result was better than what I would have specced myself. Read All
author: Jacob Yang
summary_zh: 独立开发者分享用 Claude 在约三天内构建第五款 AI 产品 Tracetify（输入 URL 生成竞品发布时间线）的经历，并完全让 Claude 主导所有 UI 设计决策，结果优于自己预设的方案。文章体现了 AI 编程工具在快速产品原型和设计决策委托上的实际应用，但内容偏简短且带产品推广性质。
